themes.label: Regional bank net interest margin cycle
themes.rationale: M&T's earnings are highly sensitive to the path of Fed policy rates and deposit repricing, which drive net interest margin, its dominant revenue driver as a traditional spread lender.

themes.label: Commercial real estate credit stress
themes.rationale: M&T carries substantial CRE and office-related loan exposure; credit normalization or deterioration in this book is a recurring theme across regional banks with similar concentrations.

themes.label: Deposit competition and funding costs
themes.rationale: Rising deposit betas and competition for funding from money-market funds and higher-rate alternatives directly affect M&T's cost of funds and margin, a shared pressure across regional banks.

themes.label: Bank capital and regulatory requirements
themes.rationale: Evolving capital rules (e.g., Basel III endgame proposals) affect M&T's capital planning, buybacks, and balance sheet growth, a force shared with other large regional banks near stress-test thresholds.

themes.label: Regional bank M&A and consolidation
themes.rationale: M&T's scale and past acquisitions (e.g., People's United) place it within an industry-wide consolidation trend among regional banks seeking scale efficiencies amid rising compliance costs.
